[P2] Preserve the SDK call's semantic sequence

This removes the sequence assigned by `_causal_order()`. When a dispatched checkpoint or poll precedes `admission_closed` or `wrapper_return` within the same millisecond, `no_late_dispatch()` receives a request without a sequence. `CaseView.at_or_after()` then uses its inclusive timestamp fallback and incorrectly reports a late dispatch, despite the recorded order proving otherwise. Preserve the event sequence in `sdkRequests` and cover a dispatch immediately before a closure at the same timestamp.
